unsupported: Cleveland Creek Home Furnishings operates from Broomfield, Colorado, with a warehouse in Golden and three retail showrooms in Golden, Boulder, and Lakewood.
The shop specializes in custom handmade wood furniture and home accessories, covering bedroom, dining, living room, and office categories.
Production takes place at the Golden warehouse, while the showrooms display a fraction of the available designs; pricing varies by style and wood selection.
The primary customers are residential buyers, interior designers, and homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind pieces for private homes.
The product line includes beds, dining tables, living room seating, and office furniture, all positioned as heirloom-quality items meant to last lifetimes.
The company states its mission is to provide furniture that is second to none, sourced and constructed in the most conscientious and responsible ways.
